## WF1 — Nightly Generator (logic complete)
Runs at 06:00 in TZ America/New_York. Also exposes the `fb-generate-now` webhook (verify the `x-webhook-secret: __N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET__` header — n8n redacts Authorization) that the Dashboard 'Generate Now' button calls with { scheduled_date, media_type? }.

2026-07-19 ASYNC RESPONSE: the webhook responds { queued: true } immediately after the secret check (Respond Queued / Respond Unauthorized 401 — same pattern as WF3) and generation continues in the background; the Dashboard polls the calendar for the draft. Two dedupe guards protect the on-demand path from double-click / error-page-retry duplicates: a 3-minute recent-post check at start, and an insert-time check keyed to run_started.

Pipeline: pick plan slot (with any APPROVED Strategist brief) or LRU subtopic → message bank + prompts → archetype → Anthropic generator → tolerant JSON parse → image prompt → Generate Image (OpenAI gpt-image-1; portrait 1024x1536 for video, square otherwise) → decode → PUT upload to the PUBLIC fb-images bucket → set public image_url → **Video post?**.

MEDIA DECISION: Build Generator Prompt sets media_type from the approved brief — video when the brief has a video_concept or a reel/video/motion recommended_format, else image (on-demand + no-brief always image).

VIDEO branch (media_type='video'): Generate Video (fal) animates the seed image into a 9:16 clip via fal Veo 3.1 image-to-video (model swappable via $env.FAL_ANIMATE_MODEL / fb_settings.animate_still_model; default fal-ai/veo3.1/fast/image-to-video; generate_audio=false), uploads the MP4 to the PUBLIC fb-videos bucket, and inserts an fb_posts row (media_type='video', video_status='pending', image_status='approved' seed). Requires the `FAL_KEY` n8n env var; without it the node throws (no post inserted). fal renders can take 1–3 min, so this workflow's executionTimeout is raised to 600s — confirm EXECUTIONS_TIMEOUT on the instance allows it.

IMAGE branch: inserts fb_posts (media_type='image', copy/image 'pending') as before. Both inserts converge → Mark Plan Generated → Bump Subtopic → GroupMe.

Replace `YOUR_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` and `__...__` placeholders with credentials/values on import. Keep `active:false` in the committed copy.
